name: Reckless Charge
scope: The defense penalty and ordinary opportunity-attack movement apply after the whole attack, not just Strong.

name: Get Out of Here
scope: All three tiers throw the target; direction, landing Prone and collisions therefore apply to every throw.

name: Cleave
scope: Standard also pushes; its collisions cannot be restricted to Strong.

name: Relentless Pursuit
scope: Every tier applies Slowed, so the condition's decay rule applies to all three.

name: Shatter the Guard
scope: This separate sentence follows the three damage clauses and grants the shared resistance loss/ally benefit.

name: Radiant Threshold
scope: Width, duration, ally exclusions, damage triggers, once-per-turn cap and non-blocking geometry describe every line.

name: Open the Way
scope: The completion condition, silent work and pre-roll DA risk statement apply to the progress project, not only a Strong attempt.

name: Fast Talk
anchor: The DA sets the progress target
scope: The pre-roll target, completion rule and limits on persuasion apply to the entire progress procedure.

name: Triage
scope: The two-recipient branch has its own three tiers; resistance/cap and target/recovery restrictions apply generally.

name: Steady Voice
anchor: If the target has neither condition
scope: The source explicitly names both Standard and Strong here; placing it exclusively in Strong hides Standard applicability.

name: Mend
scope: Life resistance, the healing cap, stabilization prerequisite, wound limit and Last Words limit govern every beneficial result.

name: Mend the Wound
anchor: This counts as the wound's one treatment attempt
scope: The daily treatment count, kit exception and no-direct-HP/no-scar-removal limits govern every treatment result.

name: The Cannonball
anchor: If you cannot move at least 2 squares
scope: The minimum movement prerequisite and collision procedure apply to the ability. Strong's preceding self-damage/Daze sentence remains correctly Strong-specific.

name: Rampage
anchor: If you cannot move at least 2 squares
scope: Minimum movement and no-further-movement limits apply to the charge, not solely its Strong result.

name: Grab and Hurl
scope: Standard also throws; collision resolution and ending this ability's grapple apply to that throw too.

name: Earthbreaker
scope: Object damage, collision handling and the caster not moving describe the entire area effect.

name: Charge
scope: Every result pushes; collision handling and the minimum-movement prerequisite apply to the whole charge.

name: The Green Spear
anchor: The spear disappears after the attack.
scope: The spear's disappearance and ammunition/free-hand exceptions govern the attack on every result.

name: Twin Strike
anchor: You can target the same creature
scope: Target allocation and the after-both-attacks defense Boon govern the complete two-attack procedure.

name: Death from the Blind Spot
anchor: If you cannot reach a square adjacent
scope: This is an ability-use prerequisite, not a restriction that begins only after a Strong result.

name: Volley
anchor: Roll once using the worst applicable
scope: Worst-pool selection, per-target resistance and one-hit-per-use govern every target and result.
